metadata.name: !Extra Birthright Effects
metadata.description:
This mod adds alternative Birthright effects for characters as a replacement or supplementary to the original effects. Right now not all characters have extra effects.
View birthright additions in our [url=https://pastebin.com/d0zNMcc8]Pastebin![/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=836319872]External item descriptions[/url] with English, Russian and Spanish languages.
Found bugs report in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2599533991/3032600513503901042/]Bugs[/url] topic.
[h1]Credits:[/h1] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/the_conservatory]The Conservatory[/url] - original ideas for Birthright effects and some coding. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/brakedude/]BrakeDude[/url] - main coder, Russian translation. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198813796283]Kotry[/url] - Spanish translation, playtesting, thumbnail.
